setup: Read-only runtime TLS transaction, bounded20s statements, aggregates only. Missing/denied relations are named; no elevation.

queries.familiesToCore: SELECT count(*) family_addresses,count(m.id) addresses_with_core_match,count(DISTINCT f.match_id) addressed_matches,count(DISTINCT m.id) core_matches FROM statarena_app.match_families f LEFT JOIN statarena_app.matches m ON m.id=f.match_id
queries.publishedScopes: SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT season),count(DISTINCT league_id) FROM statarena_app.partitions
queries.rawPayloadClasses: SELECT namespace,CASE WHEN path ~ '\.(webp|png|jpg|jpeg|svg|gif|avif)$' THEN 'images' WHEN path ~ '\.json(l)?(\.gz)?$' THEN 'structured-json' ELSE 'other' END kind,count(*),sum(size),sum(chunk_count) FROM statarena.file_payloads GROUP BY namespace,kind ORDER BY namespace,kind
queries.sourceDocFormats: SELECT format,count(*) FROM statarena.file_documents GROUP BY format ORDER BY format
queries.jobStates: SELECT status,count(*) FROM statarena.jobs GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
queries.publisherLease: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_locks WHERE locktype='advisory' AND objid=97813003 AND granted
queries.activityByDb: SELECT datname,application_name,usename,state,count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname IN ('statarena','statarena_prod') GROUP BY1,2,3,4 ORDER BY1,2,3,4
